title: Guess the number
prompt:
Two players, one input. The first number is the secret (player 1 types it while player 2 looks away), and every number after it is one of player 2's guesses. For each guess that misses, print `higher` if the secret is bigger than the guess, or `lower` if it is smaller. When a guess hits, print `correct! guesses = N`, where N counts every guess including the one that hit, and stop reading.

The starter reads the secret into `secret_r` and holds the messages. The loop has to read a guess before it has anything to test, so its body always runs at least once: a post-test loop fits. The input always ends with a correct guess.

## what is checked

- with the input `50 25 75 50` (one number per line) the program prints `higher`, `lower`, then `correct! guesses = 3`, one per line, and returns 0
- the checker also plays games you do not see, including a first guess that hits and secrets of zero or below
starter:
// a guessing game: the first number in the input is the secret,
// every number after it is a guess

define(fp, x29)
define(lr, x30)

define(secret_r, x19)
define(guess_r, x20)
define(count_r, x21)

.data
fmt_in:     .string "%ld"
msg_higher: .string "higher\n"
msg_lower:  .string "lower\n"
fmt_win:    .string "correct! guesses = %ld\n"

.bss
.balign 8
secret_m:   .skip 8
guess_m:    .skip 8

.text
        .balign 4
        .global main
main:
        stp     fp, lr, [sp, -16]!
        mov     fp, sp

        ldr     x0, =fmt_in                 // read the secret
        ldr     x1, =secret_m
        bl      scanf
        ldr     x9, =secret_m
        ldr     secret_r, [x9]

        mov     count_r, 0

        // TODO: read a guess into guess_m and count it. Print
        // msg_higher when the secret is bigger than the guess and
        // msg_lower when it is smaller. Keep going until a guess
        // matches the secret, then print fmt_win with the count.

        mov     w0, 0
        ldp     fp, lr, [sp], 16
        ret

hiddenCases.stdout:
higher
lower
higher
higher
higher
correct! guesses = 6
